base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral base portrait for a codec-style radio-call character, to be animated through separate mouth and eyelid patches. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG. Original mature graphic-novel character painting, restrained realistic anatomy, painterly but crisp facial features, muted cinematic color. Front-facing, upright and centered head-and-shoulders, whole head and both ears visible, head fixed vertically with eyes near 43 percent canvas height and mouth near 63 percent. Eyes fully OPEN looking at viewer; lips gently CLOSED, relaxed neutral expression. Face is clearly illuminated with soft even key light; preserve visible detail in the cheeks and jaw, avoid underexposure. Plain quiet charcoal-teal backdrop. Radio framing and scanlines are supplied by the app: NO border, UI, text, letters, symbols, logos, scanlines, glow or watermark. One person only, no props crossing the face, no expressive head tilt. This is the base state, not a speaking or blinking pose. An original androgynous adult communications operator in their thirties, medium olive skin, short softly textured dark-brown hair, hazel eyes, smooth face, calm approachable gender-neutral features. Simple slate-blue crew jacket and charcoal collar with a tiny unobtrusive radio earpiece. Understated, flexible and welcoming general-purpose assistant; no specific franchise resemblance.
